summaryZh: 只移除照片中指定的杂物及其对应阴影或倒影，依据周边纹理和透视补全背景，保留其余主体、建筑与画面颜色。
summaryEn: Remove only selected distractions and their own shadows or reflections, rebuilding the revealed background from nearby texture and perspective.
sampleTitleZh: 场景杂物消除参考样片
samplePrompt: An ordinary realistic photograph of a quiet paved riverside walkway beside a low stone parapet, one large tree at image left and one small empty red plastic bucket standing in the lower-right foreground as a clearly removable distraction. The river and distant tree-lined bank remain visible. Soft midday daylight, coherent paving lines, no people, bicycles, signs, text, logos or watermark. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280.
sampleAnalysis: Planned synthetic source: An ordinary realistic photograph of a quiet paved riverside walkway beside a low stone parapet, one large tree at image left and one small empty red plastic bucket standing in the lower-right foreground as a clearly removable distraction. The river and distant tree-lined bank remain visible. Soft midday daylight, coherent paving lines, no people, bicycles, signs, text, logos or watermark. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Verify the actual generated source before publishing; the planned description does not override observed facts. Allowed result changes: Delete only the selected object and its own shadow or reflection; the sample removes the lower-right red bucket. Preserve every other subject, perspective, crop and color.
mediumAnchor: A seamless photographic object-removal edit with locally reconstructed texture, geometry, lighting and depth.

fragments.text: Remove only the object explicitly selected by the user; in the catalog sample remove the red bucket in the lower-right foreground.
Keep overall colors, exposure and white balance unchanged rather than regrading the whole image.
Reconstruct revealed edges and perspective using surrounding paving, wall or landscape geometry.
Continue nearby surface texture naturally without repeated patterns, blur patches or smeared detail.
Remove the selected object shadow and reflection only where they demonstrably belong to that object.
Keep all other people, objects, architectural features and the original crop in exactly the same positions.
Do not replace the removed object with a new prop or shift adjacent subjects to hide the edit.
Return one natural photograph with invisible repair boundaries and no text or watermark.

preserve: Identity, age, expression and body proportions of observed people.
Exact geometry and recognizable details of subjects not explicitly selected for change.
Camera viewpoint and original composition except changes specifically permitted by this Skill.
negative: Unrequested people, duplicate subjects or malformed anatomy.
New logos, watermarks or unreadable pseudo-lettering.
Clipping the main subject or erasing its identifying features.
acceptanceZh: 指定杂物与专属阴影已移除。
背景纹理和透视连续，无涂抹或重复块。
未选中的主体和建筑保持原位。
没有换色、裁切、替代物或文字。
acceptanceEn: The selected distraction and its own shadow are removed.
Background texture and perspective continue without smears or repeating patches.
Unselected subjects and architecture remain in place.
No recoloring, crop, replacement object or text is introduced.
geometryNoteZh: 允许删除明确选中的物件和只属于它的投影倒影；样片删除右下红桶。保留其余主体位置、建筑线条、原始裁切和总体色彩。
geometryNoteEn: Delete only the selected object and its own shadow or reflection; the sample removes the lower-right red bucket. Preserve every other subject, perspective, crop and color.

sourceProvenance.source_text:
Remove [object_to_remove] from the uploaded image, including its associated cast shadow and reflection only where they belong to that object. Reconstruct the revealed background seamlessly using the surrounding scene's texture, geometry, perspective, lighting, and depth of field.

Preserve every other person, object, edge, and architectural feature. Do not replace the removed object with anything new, shift nearby subjects, crop the image, or alter overall colors. Avoid smears, repeating texture patterns, blurred patches, and visible edit boundaries. Output one natural-looking image with the original dimensions and framing.
modifications: Rebound the network prompt to a user-supplied reference photograph and observed source subjects.
Removed named brands, existing fictional characters, copied example subjects and unnecessary text.
Added explicit permitted changes, preservation boundaries and bilingual acceptance criteria.
Split the adapted mechanism into ordered bounded fragments; sample output uses a 4:5 catalog default.
No upstream input or example image was copied; the repository examples are generated independently.
